items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: They had Adolph Alexander playing sax, you know. But not in the old days.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. That fills it out. Yeah. But did they use any saxes in those days, like they do now? They all had saxes on the band.
Well, they, they, they, we had saxes in later days, you know. Later days. Yeah, later days. They had Adolph Alexander playing sax, you know. But not in the old days.
